query:
query {
  StorefrontUsers(where: {_or: [{emailLower: {_eq: "skio-customer@example.com"}}]}, limit: 5) {
    id
    email
    firstName
    lastName
    phoneNumber
    platformId
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    Subscriptions(limit: 10) {
      id
      status
      statusContext
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      storefrontUserId
      currencyCode
      nextBillingDate
      platformId
      cyclesCompleted
      cancelledAt
      BillingPolicy {
        id
        interval
        intervalCount
        isMaxCycleV2
        maxCycles
        minCycles
      }
      DeliveryPolicy {
        id
        interval
        intervalCount
        isMaxCycleV2
        maxCycles
        minCycles
      }
    }
  }
}
